channel.title: Homeworld Press
channel.description: Independent editorial coverage of sci-fi literature, technology, space science, and tested buyer's guides.

item.title: A Galaxy Statistic Asks the Ocean Where Its Water Connects
item.description: A borrowed connectivity measure describes a flow by how its regions link, not by where a contour closes. The sea, unlike the sky, can put that description to a test.

item.title: The Model Code Decides What a Headphone Discount Means
item.description: Holiday gear lists compare one product name across silent hardware revisions. The printed code under the ear cushion is the field a buyer can actually check.

item.title: Faster DNA insertion leaves target choice as the useful half
item.description: A redesign that raises how often a protein writes DNA also exposes the contacts used to decide where. Only the second claim travels between experiments.

item.title: The Discounts on One Black Friday Page All Add Up
item.description: Seventy-eight product cards reconcile their percentages to the point. Eight of them describe a price the reader should not pay.

item.title: Carbon Nanotubes Give Rival Electron Models a Common Test
item.description: Measurements reported on November 25, 2026 favored a collective description of conduction in a one-dimensional wire. Whether that counts depends on which observable was measured.

item.title: A Dark-Matter Telescope Anomaly Arrives Before Its Number
item.description: The notice supplies a send stamp and a research goal rather than a measurement. That gap is a normal stage of survey astronomy, and it is the informative part.

item.title: Simulated Moon Dust Grows a Potato Root Fine
item.description: A substrate trial showed tuber crops tolerate crushed rock under lamps. Water, nitrogen, energy and gravity were never supplied by the dirt.

item.title: Clipper Picks Up Speed From Earth and Pays for Instruments
item.description: The pass is where a launch vehicle limit turns into instrument mass. Timing data, not photographs, will decide whether it worked.

item.title: Xteink's Price Cut Pushes the Whole Argument Onto Support
item.description: The X4 Classic's Black Friday price sits under the cost of a phone case, so the buying decision now turns on the return window, the firmware and the support address.

item.title: A Chromosome Editing Workflow Pushes the Bottleneck Back Into Tissue Culture
item.description: Rearranging whole plant chromosomes at chosen addresses has been demonstrated before. What is scarce is a procedure a difficult genotype can survive.
